description: This file defines an interface 'EndpointResult' within the OrangeHRM Core API V2 namespace. It specifies methods for normalizing the object to an array and retrieving metadata and relationship parameters, serving as a contract for endpoint result representations in the API.
external_methods: assuming methods of ParameterBag as external

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns the normalized array representation of the endpoint result object.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns a ParameterBag containing metadata, or null if none.

methods.name: getRels
methods.description: Returns a ParameterBag containing relationships, or null if none.
